player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Connect Four.
Your disc symbol: {symbol}.
The game board has {num_rows} rows and {num_cols} columns.
Players take turns dropping their disc into one of the columns (0 to {end_col}).
The first to connect (their own) four discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally wins.
On your turn, enter the column number in squared brackets to make your move.
For example: '[col 4]' or '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Ifishi itorero siyo. Ifishi iliyotarajiwa: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Itorero siyo. Kigozo {col} kiri hanoze.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.

action.dropped_disk: Umukinnyi {player_id} yashikije diski ye ({player_symbol}) mu kigozo {col}.

outcome.draw: Urwo rukino rwarangiye ari ubusa ku bundi.
